name: Mud cracks 2: uneven drying
description: A wet layer drying everywhere, a little unevenly: its drying rate and toughness vary in smooth, rough-edged patches, so cracks open here and there, run until they meet older ones, and settle into a network of polygons. Paint dry to dry some places first, or grip for smaller polygons. Takes a while to start: the layer has to dry quite a lot before the first cracks.
